topcode.text: #  = indicates a wage equal to or greater than $115.00 per hour or $239,200 per year

_meta.not_available_note: *  = indicates that a wage estimate is not available

field_definitions.ANNUAL: Contains "TRUE" if only annual wages are released. The OEWS program releases only annual wages for some occupations that typically work fewer than 2,080 hours per year, but are paid on an annual basis, such as teachers, pilots, and athletes.
field_definitions.HOURLY: Contains "TRUE" if only hourly wages are released. The OEWS program releases only hourly wages for some occupations that typically work fewer than 2,080 hours per year and are paid on an hourly basis, such as actors, dancers, and musicians and singers.
field_definitions.TOT_EMP: Estimated total employment rounded to the nearest 10 (excludes self-employed).

_meta.vintage_gate: TOT_EMP equals src/data/national_employment.json for all 47 SOCs
_meta.note: Values are copied from the workbook unchanged. null means BLS did not publish that measure; nullReasons says why. Titles sharing a SOC show the same wage (never split). Hourly and annual figures are separate BLS columns; neither is derived from the other here.
